The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected numerical values (e.g., H46 expected -2.7657, got #NAME?). This indicates that the formulas used for the 'statistics' label are either using undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax in the generated worksheet.
